name: Mem0
description: Connect Mem0 to Claude to give your agent persistent memory across sessions. Claude can store user preferences, project context, and conversation history, then search, update, or forget them as new information comes in. Useful for coding assistants that remember your codebase conventions, support agents that recall customer history, research workflows that build context over weeks, or any use case where Claude resets back to zero today. Memories are scoped per user, agent, or session. Cloud-hosted, no local install.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mem0 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mem0 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mem0 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mem0 provides these MCP tools: add_memory, search_memories, get_memories, get_memory, update_memory, delete_memory, delete_all_memories, list_entities, delete_entities, list_events, and get_event_status.
